facts.text: I am in the process of buying a new home.
I need help organizing paperwork for finalizing the deal on my new home.
I have been house hunting for a while.
I fell in love with a 2-bedroom condo on February 15th.
The 2-bedroom condo had modern appliances and a community pool.
My offer for the 2-bedroom condo was rejected on the 17th due to a higher bid.
I want to organize documents by the timeline of the home-buying process.
I had a home inspection done on a 3-bedroom townhouse I am buying.
The 3-bedroom townhouse is in the Brookside neighborhood.
The home inspector found minor issues with the plumbing system.
The home inspector found minor issues with the electrical systems.
I negotiated with the seller to fix the minor plumbing and electrical issues.
I came to an agreement with the seller to fix the minor plumbing and electrical issues.
The seller has agreed to fix the minor plumbing and electrical issues.
I am planning to schedule a final walk-through inspection before closing.
I am considering getting a third-party contractor to review the repairs and provide an independent assessment.
I plan to ask my real estate agent for recommendations.
My real estate agent has been very helpful throughout the process.
I trust my real estate agent's judgment.
I am looking for a contractor with expertise in plumbing and electrical systems.
I am considering getting a final appraisal of the property before closing.
I want to make sure the value of the property hasn't changed since the initial appraisal.
